name: Make Noise
source:
After a tiresome year of work in a new small town, you can't help but find interest in a lonely middle aged barista you regularly chat with. Turns out there's reasons as to why he's left alone.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20240814171902/https://wes-tooth.itch.io/make-noise-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个新的小镇辛苦工作了一年后，你情不自禁地对经常与你聊天的一位孤独的中年咖啡师产生了兴趣。事实证明，他独自一人是有原因的。

[来自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20240814171902/https://wes-tooth.itch.io/make-noise-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
